title: Containers
description: Per-container health, resource use and restarts from the Docker API, plus the aggregated container stdout from Loki.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Substring filter applied to every log panel on this dashboard.

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: Filters both the metric and the log panels.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Containers the Docker engine reports as running.

panels.title: Stopped
panels.description: Containers in a non-running state; the panels below only cover running ones.

panels.title: Unhealthy
panels.description: Containers whose Docker healthcheck reports unhealthy. Only backend_db and redis define one.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Uptime counter resets, so manual restarts count too.

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: Sum over all containers; 100% is one full core.

panels.title: Log lines/s
panels.description: Aggregated container stdout.

panels.title: Errors/s
panels.description: Container stdout lines matching error/traceback/fatal/panic.

panels.title: Container status
panels.description: One row per running container. Health comes from the numeric docker_container_health_state; containers without a Docker healthcheck have no series and read as 'no check'. Stopped containers drop out of the Docker API query entirely and are counted by the Stopped stat.

panels.title: Top CPU
panels.description: Busiest containers right now; 100% is one full core.

panels.title: Top memory
panels.description: Largest resident sets right now.

panels.title: Top log volume (range)
panels.description: Loudest containers over the selected range. A container climbing here is usually retrying something.

panels.title: Container up/down
panels.description: A bar means the Docker API reported the container that scrape. Gaps are downtime.

panels.title: Health over time
panels.description: Docker healthcheck state. Only containers that define a healthcheck appear.

panels.title: Restarts in range
panels.description: Uptime counter resets over the selected range, so manual restarts count too.

panels.title: Uptime by container
panels.description: Time since each container last started.

panels.title: CPU % by container
panels.description: 100% is one full core.

panels.title: Memory % of limit
panels.description: Containers without an explicit memory limit are measured against total host RAM, so a low number there is expected.

panels.title: Network by container
panels.description: Transmit is mirrored below the zero line.

panels.title: Disk I/O by container
panels.description: Block I/O per container. Writes are mirrored below the zero line.

panels.title: Log lines/s by container
panels.description: Stacked stdout volume. The unlabelled series is grafana, which is tailed from its log file.

panels.title: Error lines/s by container
panels.description: Container stdout lines matching error/traceback/fatal/panic.

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: Aggregated stdout of every container, each line prefixed with its container name. nginx access/error and the daphne access log are written to files, not stdout - they live on Nginx and Backend.
